Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth nourishing reach and opening form
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Sage: the source spring, nourishment that never announces itself. Care flows from you the way aquifers feed valleys, invisibly, constantly, taken for granted precisely because it never fails. You absorb others’ storms and hand back calm. Watch your own water table. Springs fail silently first.
candidates.k2_functional: You think in absorbed understanding: knowledge soaked up whole, recalled as instinct.

k2_domain_readings.Knowledge: Your knowledge is absorbed rather than studied: understanding soaked from every source you touch. You know more than your credentials admit. Let it surface. Springs are meant to be found.
k2_domain_readings.Shelter: Your shelter is stillness: people pour out their storms and you hand back a level surface. That absorption has a cost curve. Drain what you take in somewhere safe.
k2_domain_readings.Nurture: The nourishing thread runs like groundwater. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. You refill it where it ran dry.

angles.drive: You calm people down without trying to. Taking in someone's worry costs you less than watching them carry it, so you take it in and give back something steadier. Let a little of it out somewhere, because calm you only absorb runs dry.
angles.cost_self: Being the calm one is a job you never put down. You take in other people's upset and level it, while yours waits for a quiet that never comes. You leave your own upset unsettled until you let someone steady you for once.
angles.cost_others: When someone close to you is upset, you become the calm for both. Being needed suits you more than being known, and your own trouble never shows. Let them see you shaken sometimes, because calm with nothing behind it keeps people at a distance.

angles.drive: You soak things up rather than study them. It settles into you from whatever is nearby, so you know a thing long before you can pass a test on it. You can trust the gap, since the proof turns up later than the understanding.
angles.cost_self: Soaking it up is how learning stays with you. Sitting with it until it is yours comes easier than proving it on paper, and the proof is the part you skip. Get the paper once, because the chances asking for it close without you.
angles.cost_others: Soaking up what someone says comes ahead of deciding whether you agree. Taking it in is easier than pushing back, so your disagreement stays where it helps no one. You help more with an honest no than a kind yes, and yours is already there.

angles.drive: Being patient comes easily to you. Letting a thing come in its own time feels more honest than forcing it, and you can wait on a question for months. Keep your pace, because the price is only the chance that needed a push.
angles.cost_self: Being patient also means you never have to ask. Waiting for a thing to come to you feels easier than reaching, so the wanting stays quiet until the chance passes. You gave up what you never asked for without noticing, and one question changes that.
angles.cost_others: You wait for a person to be ready rather than hurry them toward it. Not hurrying feels like respect, and you let someone stay stuck longer than kindness needed. Push sometimes, because being patient is also the hand you kept back.

angles.drive: You let things drift rather than decide them, and you call it patience. There is more Water in you than you turn into motion, so choosing costs more than going along. Remember that when you drift you are choosing too, just not the outcome.
angles.cost_self: Drifting keeps the days quiet, and quiet feels like care. Stirring nothing costs less than reaching, and you renew the lease rather than ask what you want. Do not lose sight of how little you learn of your own wants while nothing changes at home.
angles.cost_others: Whatever you let drift, you leave to someone else. Being carried feels easier than steering, and you let the people close to you make the calls you never did. It helps to remember that you hand them the weight of every call you dodge.

angles.drive: You stay where it is safe long after outgrowing it. Shelter is the thing you trust most, so you pick the known ahead of the better whenever the two come apart. Remember that you keep the shelter even after you walk out of it.
angles.cost_self: Staying in is how you avoid being tested. Not being ready feels more honest than being ready, and you stay long past the day leaving was open to you. Never forget that you give up the very chances the shelter was for by staying in.
angles.cost_others: Staying sheltered keeps you home while others go out. You pick being safe ahead of being there, and watch the invitations thin out instead of going. You hand those you love your safety in place of your company, and the swap is yours to notice.

angles.drive: You over-protect the people you love from what they could survive. Watching someone struggle hurts you more than doing it for them, so the help comes before the asking. Keep in mind how completely you can protect someone, until not even the lesson reaches them.
angles.cost_self: Over-protecting the ones you love never rests. Taking the hit for someone is easier for you than watching them take it, so you carry what was never yours. Bear in mind what you pay in rest for every hit you absorb for another person.
angles.cost_others: Whenever someone you love is about to struggle, you over-protect and step in first. Sparing them the hard part feels like love, and you choose their comfort rather than their growing. Remember that you take from them the one lesson that would have stuck.

retired_2026-09-20_batch3.fn_reading.catalyst.Serene.scene: The kitchen caught fire, briefly, at the family gathering, and your voice never left its usual register: pan lid, baking soda, window, done. The story afterward was all about the flames. You remember it as four small tasks that happened to be slightly warm.
retired_2026-09-20_batch3.k2_domain_readings.Mother: The mother-thread runs like groundwater: nurture that seeped in early and constant, or a dryness you learned to spring against. You became water for others either way. Refill upstream.

edge.lead: Water runs through your family, your mind and your health. It is the quiet you bring home that everyone there settles into, the knowledge that soaks into you from just being nearby, and the slow pace your body keeps thanking you for.
